blocks.text: Picking labor sits outside the tag.
Last week's tag on Linen tea towel was forty two dollars and ninety five cents. Today's item figure thirty dollars and fifteen cents matches the tag. That drop is real.
Hinge pin is offered at $3.75 and is not ticked, so it stays off the amount due.
The shelf card lists nine on hand in the stockroom.

product.description: The towel is linen, hemmed, for drying cups.
product.name: Linen tea towel

trick.instruction: If you can clear Picking labor, clear it. If Picking labor is required and the amount due is over the errand limit, leave without paying.
